items.caption: This Shang oracle-script-style redraw shows a central upright stroke with diagonal strokes descending from its junction and two strokes diverging below. The whole graph is interpreted as a human figure, though its pose is disputed.
items.alt: Black glyph with a central upright stroke, two diagonals descending from its junction, and two lower strokes diverging on white.
items.selection_reason: It offers an early script-style example of the whole-graph human-figure interpretation; the redraw does not settle the figure’s pose or original sense.
items.period: Shang oracle-bone script style; the redraw is not a securely dated specimen.

limitations.text: The selected image is a modern redraw in Shang oracle-bone script style, not a photograph of a dated artifact. Sources agree on a human-figure interpretation but differ on the pose; the shape alone does not establish the figure’s original meaning.

The seal-style redraw is omitted because it adds little to the explanation beyond the selected early form. The available redraws show broad stylistic comparison, not specific graphic changes or a dated sequence of uses.
